title: Example: AI model development and evaluation studies
description: A reference template showing single groups, repeatable groups and related records. Replace it with the protocol-approved extraction form for your review.
instructions: Extract only what the paper reports. Report each dataset, model and result as a separate record.

fields.label: Study aim
fields.description: The primary objective of the study in one or two sentences.

fields.label: Study design
fields.instructions: Classify by the main contribution of the paper.

fields.label: Country of data collection
fields.description: Countries where the study data were collected (not the authors' affiliations).

fields.label: Code availability
fields.instructions: Use 'Not reported' if the paper does not mention code availability.

fields.label: Population
fields.description: Who the data come from (condition, care setting, inclusion criteria).

fields.label: Number of participants
fields.description: Total number of unique participants/patients across all data used.
fields.instructions: Do not confuse participants with recordings or samples.

fields.label: Age (mean or median)
fields.instructions: Put the summary statistic (mean/median, SD/IQR) in the context.

groups.label: Datasets
groups.description: One record per distinct dataset used in the study.

fields.label: Size
fields.description: Number of samples or recordings in the dataset as used.

groups.label: Models
groups.description: One record per model, including proposed models and baselines.

fields.label: Proposed by the authors
fields.description: True for the authors' own model, false for baselines.

groups.label: Results
groups.description: One record per reported performance value (metric x model x dataset x setting).
groups.instructions: For values from tables, quote the table row containing the value and give the row and column headings in the context.

fields.label: Value
fields.instructions: The number exactly as reported; give the unit separately and any uncertainty in its own field.

fields.label: Uncertainty
fields.description: 95% CI, SD or range as reported.

fields.label: Evaluation setting
fields.description: e.g. internal test split, external validation, 5-fold cross-validation, zero-shot.
